verdict.rationale: Conductor is documented as a Mac app for running many coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) in parallel. Each task gets its own workspace, worktree, branch, terminal, diff and review path. Sessions are organized in one app through sidebar sections and a Home view of everyone's work, and multiple agents can also share one workspace. Community users describe it as a handy UI over parallel worktrees for Claude Code. Missing for 10: support for sessions spanning multiple repos (a user reports tools like this are built around a single repo), and deeper hands-on corroboration of managing many sessions at once.
